paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Ami said in the name of Rabbi Pedat, who spoke in Rabbi Yochanan’s name: [Berakhot 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.7).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=961&lang=en) have Pedat (פדת), beside פרת in the supplied Hebrew. The chain introduces the teaching about a troubling dream.
